shortDescription: According to CNBC, a China-Africa liner carrying 23,800 tons of mechanical equipment and engineering vehicles departed from Yantai Port for Ghana on Sept. 3, 2026. The vessel left Yantai City in Shandong Province, China.

title: China-Africa Liner Departs Yantai For Ghana With 23,800 Tons Of Equipment
